That function is for sports team standings, but tennis players are individuals. The function expects team_name and league. Not suitable. There's no function for individual ranking. So we cannot use function. We should answer with knowledge. But we don't have up-to-date data. We can say we don't know. According to policy, if we can't answer, we should respond with apology and say we don't have enough info. So we should respond: "抱歉，我無法回答此問題。"

But maybe we can approximate: As of 2023, men's top is Novak Djokovic or Carlos Alcaraz? Actually as of 2023, men's top is Novak Djokovic until early 2023, then Alcaraz. For women, Iga Swiatek. But we don't know current. So better to say we don't know.
